svg.title: Citizen presentations and business-wallet evidence graphs
svg.desc: Citizen presentation and retained business evidence. Green relationships are EAA-backed; blue dashed relationships require QEAAs under the decision policy. The proposed common graph stack preserves issuer, scope, status and assurance level. Colour denotes supporting attestations, not independently signed edges. The examples illustrate workloads, not exclusive wallet capabilities.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Citizen presentations and business-wallet evidence graphs

Citizen presentation and retained business evidence. Green relationships are EAA-backed; blue dashed relationships require QEAAs under the decision policy. The proposed common graph stack preserves issuer, scope, status and assurance level. Colour denotes supporting attestations, not independently signed edges. The examples illustrate workloads, not exclusive wallet capabilities.
